segments.segment_summary: A man inspects a cracked metal component on a piece of red farm machinery, pointing out the damage and a previously replaced bolt.

key_moments.caption: A close-up shot shows a hand pointing to a large crack in a red metal bracket.
The man's hand adjusts a spring mechanism on the machinery.
The camera shows two bolts, one of which was previously broken and replaced.

segments.segment_summary: Men use a power grinder, a torch to heat the metal, and an impact wrench to straighten a bent plate on the farm machinery in preparation for welding.

key_moments.caption: A man uses a power grinder on the machinery's wheel assembly.
A man lights a welding torch, which produces a long, blue and orange flame.
The torch is used to heat a metal plate on the machinery until it glows red.
An impact wrench is used to tighten a bolt on the heated plate, straightening it.

segments.segment_summary: After preparing the area, a man puts on a welding helmet and welds the cracked metal component on the farm machinery, while another person adjusts the welder's settings.

key_moments.caption: A man wearing a welding helmet begins to weld the metal plate, creating bright sparks.
A hand turns the voltage dial on a Miller Millermatic 250 welding machine.
Intense sparks fly as the man welds along the joint of the metal parts.
A low-angle shot shows the man welding the front wheel assembly of the machinery.

segments.segment_summary: After the welding repair is complete, a man grabs a grease gun and applies grease to two different fittings on the farm machinery, then provides a summary of the work.

key_moments.caption: A man takes a blue grease gun from a tool wall in the barn.
The grease gun is attached to a fitting on the machinery's wheel assembly.
The man applies grease to a different fitting higher up on the machine's frame.
The man faces the camera and talks about the completed repair.
